root_cause: FrameworkDrawer refreshed its own revision after a nested RecordDrawer saved but did not forward the existing containing onSaved callback. The nested Source showed a reopened authoritative Finding and child while the original Action Items ticket retained its own old loaded records.
source_fix: Forward the existing containing onSaved callback after incrementing FrameworkDrawer's local revision. No Work form remount/reset, API, OrgContext, count path or native lifecycle changes.
verified_guards: The original Action Items drawer returns to the same Finding ticket identity with the new open child and retained completed original child.
The original unsaved Planned action remains in its original Work form, triggers the leave warning, and is not written to the saved Action by reading/reopening the Source.
Native implementation, status, verification, last_saved, assessment history and Evidence are unchanged by the nested ticket lifecycle mutation.
The existing actor-bound command and remediation behavior suites remain passing.
harness_corrections: The multi-round-trip regression uses a recorded saved plan and an explicit 30-second journey budget; the first post-fix run exposed a default 5-second test timeout and an undefined-versus-empty initial plan fixture assertion. No assertion was removed or skipped. Existing RemediationUX mocks emit DOM event-handler warnings.
iso_queue_test_contract: Not Assessed precedes assessed native gaps. Known audit deadlines precede an undated audit within its separate bucket. Native identity/destination, exact dates, no invented overdue state, verification-independent figures and input immutability remain checked.
limitations: This owner used isolated component/Demo transport verification and did not operate a browser, real Mongo, staging session or deployment. The compiled browser return journey must be repeated by root after integration/rebuild.
